candidate_parameters.G0: training-label agreement gated KD; no Mixup
candidate_parameters.reduction: full batch mean; no gate-count normalization

selection.fold_consistency: at least 3/5 folds improve log_loss or MCC; report all fold metrics
selection.subsets: strict25 and clean-core raw AP/AUROC drop <=0.001

calibration: Five fold cross-fit unregularized Platt on OOF logits for each arm; then fit all development for selected deployment. No old Platt applied to new models.
challenge_policy: Only selected new arm; label-free predictions saved before label merge. Prior results already known: retrospective evaluation.
limitations: Teacher-student fold dependence remains; no fully nested causal distillation claim.
OOF single-member calibration to ensemble distribution mismatch remains.
Gating changes effective loss weight on conflict records; not pure causal isolation.
Training source labels may contain noise; disagreement is not proof of erroneous biological information.
